about: Health report of a BMW car (an ENET-based BMW, MINI or Rolls-Royce), read from its control modules over the diagnostic port: each module's fault memory (active and stored faults, with the snapshot records the module saved when a fault occurred), the FSC feature activations in force, and the factory option codes of its vehicle order. Values are text, with their units.

Values are as the vehicle's control modules reported them when read, as interpreted by VAE's own analysis of BMW's diagnostic data. VAE doesn't guarantee they are complete or accurate. This report is not a substitute for an inspection by a qualified technician.

datalog.about: The values each module can record in the app's Datalog tab. An AI tool can pick some and give the driver a setup code that picks them in the app (Datalog > Setup code); setupCode.guide says how to make one. A value is a line: its DID, "*" for a common one, its name and unit, or the values it holds.
